methodology:
Genting Plantations is a hybrid palm + property developer with 243,200 ha total landbank including plasma schemes. Plantation footprint: ~64K ha Malaysia (Sabah + Peninsular) + ~178,900 ha Indonesia (West/Central/South Kalimantan). 14 oil mills total: 1 W. Malaysia + 6 Sabah + 7 Indonesia.

5-row breakdown adds named segments to the previous 2-row aggregation:
- Sabah Malaysia (110K acres + 6 mills): largest Malaysian cluster
- Peninsular Malaysia (25K acres + 1 mill): smaller W. Malaysia
- Indonesia Kalimantan (442K acres + 7 mills): largest cluster overall
- Property development (15K acres): Iskandar Malaysia + 152 ha Sentul Indonesia (RM593M July 2024 acquisition for property development = premium urban-fringe pricing)
- Genomics R&D placeholder (not land asset)

Property development segment is meaningful — GENP combines plantation + Iskandar Malaysia urban land + Indonesian urban property. Per-acre marks vary 100-200x across segments.
